signatures.description: Given a control-flow graph already lifted to SSA with redundant phi nodes from naive dominance-frontier insertion, write a pruning pass that deletes phis satisfied trivially (all operands identical, or all but one operand the phi itself) and splits only the critical edges needed so that surviving phis appear where live-in values genuinely conflict. The pass must stay correct for loops with multiple backedges, degrade conservatively on irreducible regions by inserting explicit copies, and terminate in one dominance-tree sweep without re-running liveness to a fixpoint. Deliver the implementation, a textual CFG parser/emitter round-trip, an execution-equivalence checker that compares pre- and post-pass behavior on randomized inputs, and tests covering nested loops and mutually recursive irreducible blocks.
